_comment: Golden fabrication-variant entry. See golden/README.md and CLAUDE.md 'Golden designs'. Do not hand-edit numbers; re-run the CLI.
description: Same full stack but standard OPEN plated via barrels (hollow copper shell, air core) instead of filled+capped.
IMPORTANT: Every golden entry saved BEFORE 2026-09-02 used PEC on all metal and therefore UNDERSTATES insertion loss by ~0.37dB. Compare fab variants against the pec_optimized entry, not against the older goldens.

provenance.reproduce_with: uv run python four_variants.py; uv run siw compare-fab-variants

modelling_caveat: The open via aperture is modelled as an Absorbing boundary, which absorbs ALL energy incident on it. The real 1.5mm hole is ~40x below its own 117GHz TE11 cutoff and radiates almost nothing, so this OVERESTIMATES the open-via penalty. The measured tented-vs-open difference (0.01dB) is therefore an UPPER BOUND -- and it is already negligible, which is the informative result.
